'''Christian Reinsch''' (1934 – October 8, 2022) was a German mathematician who worked in the area of [[numerical analysis]].

Reinsch began studying physics in 1953 at the [[Technical University of Munich]], graduating in 1958. He received his doctorate in 1961 studying under [[Heinz Maier-Leibnitz]].<ref>{{MathGenealogyProject|id=34158}}</ref>

Among other things, he worked in the area of [[numerical linear algebra]] and interpolation with [[Spline (mathematics)|spline functions]]. Several of his works have over two thousand citations each.<ref>{{cite journal|first1=Christian H.|last1=Reinsch|s2cid=26555189|title=Smoothing by spline functions|journal=Numerische Mathematik|date=1 October 1967|issn=0945-3245|pages=177–183|volume=10|issue=3|doi=10.1007/BF02162161}}</ref> Reinsch died on October 8, 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Obituary: Christian Reinsch |url=https://sinews.siam.org/Details-Page/obituary-christian-reinsch |access-date=2024-03-09 |website=SIAM News |language=en-US}}</ref>
